principle: Screens declare a PRIMARY_GRID_MODE; the family CSS composes it per viewport. No universal page — each grid mode is a small, named composition.

implementation.flow: AioFlow (AioMigrationModules.tsx) sorts children into top (select steps), main (cards) and side (what happens next, notes, the action bundle)

PATHS_3UP.TABLET: 3 columns 265 / 255 / 264 fr, CARD_GAP 8px, card 232px: 90px photo strip, 68px dark disc over the strip, single-line title, body, 42px gold square arrow bottom-right; the selected path has the gold border
PATHS_3UP.DESKTOP: 3 equal columns, CARD_GAP 12px, card 188px: 90px strip, title + 2-line body left, 56×46 arrow right

MAIN_SIDE.use: working screens (upload, processing, approval, detail, invite, batch)
MAIN_SIDE.TABLET: one column: steps, cards, then support panels (2-column support when there are two) and a centred moderate action
MAIN_SIDE.DESKTOP: steps across the top; main + 340px side column (gap 24px) once the main column keeps ≥ ~820px (container amg-main ≥ 1184px; module internals are drawn in phone units); the side column is sticky (top: header + 16px) and holds what happens next, notes and the action. A narrower desktop workspace stacks and pairs the support panels

CANVAS_PANEL.use: founder review and record review (review, conflicts, new-records, new-review)
CANVAS_PANEL.DESKTOP: review canvas + 320px context / actions panel, sticky — the decision stays beside the evidence (same container condition as MAIN_SIDE)
CANVAS_PANEL.TABLET: as MAIN_SIDE (canvas first, panel under it)

SINGLE.use: work with no side items (match, extract, new-extract, new-approval, batch-processing, batch-summary)
SINGLE.TABLET: one column at the full width
SINGLE.DESKTOP: one column, 1000px measure, centred in the workspace

CENTERED.use: client activation screens and the arrival
CENTERED.DESKTOP: the CLIENT OFFICE shell has no navigation: content measure 1240px centred (arrival 940px); review screens still pair the review card with what happens next
CENTERED.TABLET: one column at the full width

processModes.BAND: horizontal stages in a panel; stage count comes from the data (AioSteps --n), equal columns; connectors between dots. TABLET: title + sub stacked, 46px dots. DESKTOP: title and sub on one row, 34px dots, 6 columns inside 32px padding
processModes.STEPPER: select steps (MigrationSelectSteps) as a full-width top card at every viewport
processModes.STAGES: live stage list (vertical on phone; horizontal where the screen draws hstages)

SUPPORT_GRID.TABLET: 2 columns 413 / 376 fr: SUPPORTED FILE TYPES (four bordered tiles) + YOUR DATA IS SECURE (88px gold disc, short line)
SUPPORT_GRID.DESKTOP: 3 columns 446 / 380 / 419 fr: file types (icon, label, extension) + secure (79px disc, full sentence) + WHAT HAPPENS NEXT (78px grey disc; PREBUILT is not ACTIVE)

SIDE.TABLET: support panels pair up two per row; a single panel spans the row
SIDE.DESKTOP: stacked in the sticky side column, icon above the text

FIELDS.DESKTOP: 2 columns inside the main column (never wider than the card)

formModes.CHOICES: decision controls stay grouped with the item they decide (radio rows, choice bars); never detached into the side column

reviewRules.clientReview: DESKTOP: centred inside the CLIENT OFFICE shell (CENTERED), review card + what happens next
reviewRules.arrival: remains a celebratory arrival: full environment, ACTIVE seal, one office card, 940px measure

paths.MOBILE→TABLET: absolute card internals → grid (strip / title / body + arrow); two-line titles → one line
paths.TABLET→DESKTOP: shorter cards, arrow beside the copy, wider gaps

process.MOBILE→TABLET: authority positions → flowed band with equal columns
process.TABLET→DESKTOP: title + sub on one row; smaller dots; padded columns

support.MOBILE→TABLET: providers panel and photo callout drop out; types + secure become a 2-column row
support.TABLET→DESKTOP: third panel (what happens next) joins; secure shows the full sentence

forms.TABLET→DESKTOP: 2 columns inside the main column next to the side panel
